GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 072 (8 Apr 49) CPC/OD
(SCAPIN-1990/6)
APO 500
16 December 1950
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Procedures for Restoration of Patents, Utility Models and Designs to Allied Nationals
1. Reference is made to the following memoranda for the Japanese Government from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers:
a. File AG 072 (8 Apr 49) CPC/FP, SCAPIN 1990, 8 April 1949, subject as above
b. File AG 072 (8 Apr 49) CPC/FP, SCAPIN 1990/1, 16 May 1949, subject, “Procedures for Restoration of Patent Property in Japan to Allied Nationals.”
2. It is directed that the Japanese Government, in executing “Certificates of Restoration” as described in paragraph 3d of reference 1b above, shall specify a “Time-limit for Payment of Patent Fee” which is not less than one hundred twenty (120) days counted from the “Date of Entry of Restoration.”
3. The Japanese Government is also directed to apply retroactively the requirement contained in paragraph 2 above by amending the records of the Patent Agency where necessary to grant to owners of restored patent property the benefit of the specified minimum period for payment of the first annual fee after restoration.
4. The requirement contained in paragraph 2 above shall not apply in cases where a patent fee had become due within six (6) months before the applicable date of entry into war and had not been paid, nor will it in any way affect or delay the running of the six (6) months statutory period provided for in Article 69 of the Patent Law.
5. Direct communication is authorized between interested sections of General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers and the appropriate ministries of the Japanese Government on all matters connected with this directive.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
K.B.BUSH
Brigadier General, USA
Adjutant General
